# Notebook 00 -- Low-flow metric layer

**What this notebook does.** HYD_30 ranked the 22 bias-corrected CMIP6
models on *whole-flow* daily skill (KGE/NSE/PBIAS). This module re-simulates
the same calibrated GR4J runs (identical params, forcings, warm-up, windows --
the daily series were regenerated rather than committed, per repo convention)
and computes a **low-flow-specific metric suite** on the out-of-sample
evaluation window 2001-2014, which HYD_30 never computed:

| metric | definition (pre-registered 18 Nov 2026, `metric_version = "v1"`) |
|---|---|
| `logNSE` | NSE on log10(Q + eps), eps = 0.01 mm/day; NA if <365 paired days or zero variance of log-obs |
| `q95_bias` | % bias of the simulated low-flow index Q95 (flow exceeded 95% of time = 5th percentile of daily values, quantile type 7, paired non-NA days); NA if observed Q95 <= 0 (ephemeral) |
| `lf_volume_bias` | % bias of total simulated volume on days where observed flow <= observed Q90 threshold (10th percentile), paired days; the low-flow "deficit volume" proxy |
| `dry_spell_bias` | % bias of the mean annual maximum spell of consecutive days below the observed Q90 threshold (an NA day ends a spell); NA if the observed mean spell length is 0 |
| `mam7_bias` | % bias of the mean annual 7-day rolling-minimum flow (MAM7, trailing 7-day mean, window must be fully paired) |

**Conventions enforced here (AGENTS.md):**

* every output row carries `model`, `catchment`, `period`, `window`, `metric`,
  `value`, `n_eval_days`, `n_gap_filled`, `extrapolation_share`,
  `metric_version` and a `metric_note` reason code wherever a metric's guard
  fired -- flags propagate, never drop silently;
* catchments/models that fail a metric's guard produce a row in
  `data_processed/logs/LOWFLOW_00_exclusions.csv` with a `reason_code`;
* the pairwise Spearman correlation table between metrics is written so the
  rank-compositing module (`LOWFLOW_10`) can de-duplicate near-duplicates
  (rho > 0.9) **before** averaging -- no metric averaging without inspection;
* daily eval-window series (obs + all models) are cached per catchment under
  `data_processed/lowflow/series/` so later modules (ranks, propagation,
  GR6J divergence) never re-run the 4,000+ GR4J simulations.

```{r log-file}
low_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "lowflow")
dir.create(low_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "logs"),
           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
low_log_file <- file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_00_log.txt")
```

## 1. Configuration

```{r config}
metric_version   <- "v1"
low_metrics_vec  <- c("logNSE", "q95_bias", "lf_volume_bias",
                      "dry_spell_bias", "mam7_bias")
low_eval_start   <- hyd_valid_start          # 2001-01-01
low_eval_end     <- hyd_valid_end            # 2014-12-31
low_min_eval_days <- 3068                    # 60% of the 5,114-day window
low_log_eps      <- 0.01                     # mm/day, logNSE offset
low_q90_prob     <- 0.10                     # exceedance 90% -> 10th pct
low_q95_prob     <- 0.05                     # exceedance 95% -> 5th pct
low_spell_w      <- 7                        # MAM7 window width (days)
low_test_mode    <- FALSE                    # TRUE: 2 catchments x 2 models
low_save_series  <- TRUE                     # cache eval series as .rds
```

## 2. Roster (identical to HYD_30: calibrated + parameters on disk)

```{r roster}
calib <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_calib_summary.csv"),
                           colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- calib[status == "calibrated"]

inv <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                         colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- merge(roster, inv[, .(id, tier = final_action)], by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

params_dir <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "params")
roster <- roster[file.exists(file.path(params_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))]

topo <- data.table::fread(hyd_topo_fp, colClasses = list(character = "gauge_id"))
topo[, id := hyd_normalize_id(gauge_id)]
roster <- merge(roster, topo[, .(id, cwc_lat)], by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

if (low_test_mode) roster <- roster[id %in% c("03002", "03005")]
cat("Catchments to simulate:", nrow(roster), "\n")
```

```{r models}
ranking <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "model_ranking_overall.csv"))
models <- ranking$model[sapply(ranking$model, function(m) {

})]

```

## 4. Metric functions (guarded; every guard returns NA + a reason code)

```{r metric-fns}
# paired eval table: date, o = observed, s = simulated, both masked to pairs
low_pairs <- function(dates, o, s) {
   keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
   data.table::data.table(date = dates, o = o, s = s)[keep]
}

# --- logNSE -----------------------------------------------------------------
low_logNSE <- function(o, s) {
   ol <- log10(o + low_log_eps); sl <- log10(s + low_log_eps)
   if (length(ol) < 365 || stats::sd(ol) == 0) return(NA_real_)
   1 - sum((sl - ol)^2) / sum((ol - mean(ol))^2)
}

# --- Q95 low-flow index bias (5th percentile of paired daily values) ---------
low_q95_bias <- function(o, s) {
   q95_o <- stats::quantile(o, probs = low_q95_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   if (!is.finite(q95_o) || q95_o <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   q95_s <- stats::quantile(s, probs = low_q95_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   100 * (q95_s - q95_o) / q95_o
}

# --- low-flow volume bias (days where obs <= observed Q90) -------------------
low_volume_bias <- function(pairs, q90_o) {
   i_low <- pairs$o <= q90_o
   vol_o <- sum(pairs$o[i_low]); vol_s <- sum(pairs$s[i_low])
   if (vol_o <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (vol_s - vol_o) / vol_o
}

# --- dry-spell bias (mean annual max run below observed Q90) -----------------
low_dry_spell_bias <- function(pairs, q90_o) {
   below_o <- pairs$o < q90_o; below_s <- pairs$s < q90_o   # NA ends a spell
   yr <- as.integer(format(pairs$date, "%Y"))
   spell_year_max <- function(below, years) {
      tapply(below, years, function(b) {
         r <- rle(as.logical(b))
         if (!any(r$values)) 0L else max(r$lengths[r$values])
      })
   }
   so <- spell_year_max(below_o, yr); ss <- spell_year_max(below_s, yr)
   mo <- mean(so); ms <- mean(ss)
   if (!is.finite(mo) || mo <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (ms - mo) / mo
}

# --- MAM7 bias (mean annual minimum of trailing 7-day mean flow) -------------
low_mam7_bias <- function(pairs) {
   yr <- as.integer(format(pairs$date, "%Y"))
   roll_o <- data.table::frollmean(pairs$o, n = low_spell_w)  # NA inside runs
   roll_s <- data.table::frollmean(pairs$s, n = low_spell_w)
   # annual minimum of the rolling mean; years with no complete 7-day run
   # contribute nothing (min(na.rm=TRUE) on an all-NA year gives Inf -- drop it)
   mam7 <- function(roll, years) {
      ym <- tapply(roll, years, min, na.rm = TRUE)
      ym <- ym[is.finite(ym)]
      if (!length(ym)) NA_real_ else mean(ym)
   }
   mo <- mam7(roll_o, yr); ms <- mam7(roll_s, yr)
   if (!is.finite(mo) || mo <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (ms - mo) / mo
}
```

## 5. Simulation core (identical to HYD_30, plus daily series retention)

```{r sim-fns}
zoo_gapfill <- function(x) {
   i_na <- which(is.na(x))
   if (length(i_na) == 0) return(x)
   x[i_na] <- stats::approx(seq_along(x), x, xout = i_na, rule = 2)$y
   x
}

hyd_read_corrected <- function(model, tier, id, var) {
   dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qm_corr_dir, model, tier,
                                     paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv")),
                           select = c("date", "corrected_value", "method_flag"))
   data.table::setnames(dt, "corrected_value", var)
   data.table::setnames(dt, "method_flag", paste0("flag_", var))
   dt
}

# runs GR4J for one catchment x model; returns list(qobs, qsim, dates, flags)
low_simulate <- function(id, tier, lat, model, full_dates, i_warm, i_run_full,
                         i_eval) {
   obs <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_inputs_dir, paste0(id, "_obs.csv")),
                            select = c("date", "Qobs_mm"))
   prm <- readRDS(file.path(params_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))

   pc <- hyd_read_corrected(model, tier, id, "pr")
   tx <- hyd_read_corrected(model, tier, id, "tasmax")
   tn <- hyd_read_corrected(model, tier, id, "tasmin")
   dt <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "date", all = TRUE),
                list(pc, tx, tn))
   dt <- merge(obs, dt, by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
   dt <- dt[order(as.Date(date))]
   dt[, Tmean_C := (tasmax + tasmin) / 2]

   # noleap Feb-29 gaps: pr -> 0, T -> interpolated, count kept (never silent)
   n_gap <- sum(is.na(dt$Tmean_C))
   if (n_gap > 0) {
      dt[, Tmean_C := zoo_gapfill(Tmean_C)]
      dt[, tasmax := zoo_gapfill(tasmax)]
      dt[, tasmin := zoo_gapfill(tasmin)]
      dt[is.na(pr), pr := 0]
      if (sum(is.na(dt$Tmean_C)) > 0) stop("unfillable input gaps (n=", n_gap, ")")
   }
   dt[, PET_mm := airGR::PE_Oudin(JD = as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%j")),
                                  Temp = Tmean_C, Lat = lat, LatUnit = "deg")]

   inputs <- airGR::CreateInputsModel(FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
                                      DatesR = as.POSIXct(as.Date(dt$date)),
                                      Precip = dt$pr, PotEvap = dt$PET_mm)
   run_opt <- airGR::CreateRunOptions(FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
                                      InputsModel = inputs,
                                      IndPeriod_WarmUp = i_warm,
                                      IndPeriod_Run = i_run_full)
   out <- airGR::RunModel(inputs, run_opt, Param = prm$param,
                          FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J)

   i_eval_dt <- match(full_dates[i_eval], dt$date)
   list(qobs = dt$Qobs_mm[i_eval_dt],
        # Qsim is indexed within the run window (starts after warm-up)
        qsim = out$Qsim[i_eval - hyd_warmup_days],
        n_gap_filled = n_gap,
        extrap_eval = sum(c(dt$flag_pr[i_eval_dt], dt$flag_tasmax[i_eval_dt],
                            dt$flag_tasmin[i_eval_dt]) != "within_range",
                          na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

## 6. Metric driver (one catchment x one model -> long-format rows)

```{r driver}
# reason code for a metric that lands NA despite enough paired days
# (vectorized over the metric column; q90_o / pairs from the caller scope)
low_na_reason_vec <- function(metric, pairs, q90_o) {
   ephemeral <- (q90_o <= 0 || min(pairs$o) <= 0)
   data.table::fcase(
      metric == "logNSE",         "log_zero_variance",
      metric == "q95_bias",       if (ephemeral) "ephemeral_threshold_zero"
                                  else "q95_guard",
      metric == "lf_volume_bias", "no_days_below_q90",
      metric == "dry_spell_bias", "no_obs_dry_spell",
      metric == "mam7_bias",      "mam7_degenerate",
      default = "metric_guard")
}

low_metric_rows <- function(id, model, dates, o, s, n_gap, n_extrap) {
   pairs <- low_pairs(dates, o, s)
   n_eval <- nrow(pairs)
   extrap_share <- n_extrap / max(n_eval, 1L)

   base <- data.table::data.table(
      model = model, catchment = id,
      period = paste(format(low_eval_start), format(low_eval_end), sep = "-"),
      window = "valid",
      metric = low_metrics_vec, value = NA_real_,
      n_eval_days = n_eval, n_gap_filled = n_gap,
      extrapolation_share = round(extrap_share, 6),
      metric_version = metric_version, metric_note = NA_character_)

   if (n_eval < low_min_eval_days) {
      base[, metric_note := "insufficient_eval_days"]
      return(list(rows = base, excluded = TRUE))
   }

   q90_o <- stats::quantile(pairs$o, probs = low_q90_prob,
                            names = FALSE, type = 7)
   vals <- c(
      logNSE         = low_logNSE(pairs$o, pairs$s),
      q95_bias       = low_q95_bias(pairs$o, pairs$s),
      lf_volume_bias = low_volume_bias(pairs, q90_o),
      dry_spell_bias = low_dry_spell_bias(pairs, q90_o),
      mam7_bias      = low_mam7_bias(pairs))

   base[, value := round(as.numeric(vals), 5)]
   base[is.na(value), metric_note :=
           low_na_reason_vec(metric, pairs, q90_o)]
   list(rows = base, excluded = FALSE)
}
```

## 7. Run: catchments x models

```{r run, eval=TRUE}
full_dates <- seq(hyd_period_start, hyd_period_end, by = "day")
i_warm     <- seq(1L, hyd_warmup_days)
i_run_full <- seq(1L, length(full_dates))[-i_warm]
i_eval     <- which(full_dates >= low_eval_start & full_dates <= low_eval_end)
eval_dates <- full_dates[i_eval]

series_dir <- file.path(low_output_dir, "series")
if (low_save_series) dir.create(series_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

rows <- list(); excl <- list(); n_row <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(roster))) {
   id <- roster$id[i]; tier <- roster$tier[i]; lat <- roster$cwc_lat[i]
   res_by_model <- list(); ok_models <- character(0)

   for (m in models) {
      sim <- tryCatch(
         low_simulate(id, tier, lat, m, full_dates, i_warm, i_run_full, i_eval),
         error = function(e) {
            excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
               module = "LOWFLOW_00", catchment = id, model = m,
               reason_code = "simulation_error",
               detail = conditionMessage(e))
            NULL
         })
      if (is.null(sim)) next
      res_by_model[[m]] <- sim
      ok_models <- c(ok_models, m)
      mr <- low_metric_rows(id, m, eval_dates, sim$qobs, sim$qsim,
                            sim$n_gap_filled, sim$extrap_eval)
      rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- mr$rows
      if (mr$excluded) {
         excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
            module = "LOWFLOW_00", catchment = id, model = m,
            reason_code = "insufficient_eval_days",
            detail = paste0("n_eval_days=", mr$rows$n_eval_days[1]))
      }
   }

   if (low_save_series && length(ok_models)) {
      saveRDS(list(dates = eval_dates,
                   qobs  = res_by_model[[1]]$qobs,      # obs is model-independent
                   qsim  = do.call(cbind,
                                   lapply(res_by_model, `[[`, "qsim")),
                   models = ok_models),
              file.path(series_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))
   }
   cat("done:", id, "|", length(ok_models), "models\n")
}

low_metrics_long <- data.table::rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(low_metrics_long,
                   file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_metrics.csv"))

excl_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(excl, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(excl_dt)) {
   data.table::fwrite(excl_dt,
                      file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "logs",
                                "LOWFLOW_00_exclusions.csv"))
   cat("Exclusions logged:", nrow(excl_dt), "\n")
}
cat("metric rows:", nrow(low_metrics_long), "\n")
```

## 8. Wide view + metric pairwise correlations (guardrail 5 inspection)

```{r inspect}
low_metrics_wide <- data.table::dcast(
   low_metrics_long, model + catchment + period + window + n_eval_days +
      n_gap_filled + extrapolation_share + metric_version + metric_note ~ metric,
   value.var = "value")
data.table::fwrite(low_metrics_wide,
                   file.path(low_output_dir, "lowflow_metrics_wide.csv"))

# Spearman rho between metrics across all model x catchment rows
# (evidence base for the LOWFLOW_10 de-duplication decision; rho > 0.9 pairs
#  must NOT both enter a composite rank)
rho_tab <- cor(low_metrics_wide[, low_metrics_vec, with = FALSE],
               method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
rho_dt <- data.table::data.table(
   metric1 = rep(rownames(rho_tab), ncol(rho_tab)),
   metric2 = rep(colnames(rho_tab), each = nrow(rho_tab)),
   rho = round(as.vector(rho_tab), 3))
data.table::fwrite(rho_dt,
                   file.path(low_output_dir, "metric_pairwise_rho.csv"))
print(round(rho_tab, 3))
```

## Take-away

- `lowflow_metrics.csv` (long) + `lowflow_metrics_wide.csv` + the daily series
  cache under `series/` are the inputs of `LOWFLOW_10_ranks.Rmd`, which builds
  the low-flow-aware model ranking after the rho > 0.9 de-duplication check
  and tests **H1** (forcing rank vs low-flow rank; fails if pooled rho > 0.6).
- Every dropped catchment/metric is in `LOWFLOW_00_exclusions.csv` with a
  reason code; `extrapolation_share` and `n_gap_filled` travel with every row.
